title: Root Vegetable Rice Pilaf with Aioli
description: Persian-style rice baked with browned turnip, beetroot, sweet potato and carrot, leeks and white wine, served with a garlic aioli on the side.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Cut the turnips, beetroot, sweet potato and carrots into 1 cm cubes.

Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large frying pan and fry the root vegetable cubes in a single layer over medium heat (you will probably need to do this in batches) for 3-4 minutes until golden on all sides. Transfer to a plate lined with paper towel.

Heat 1/3 cup olive oil in a large ovenproof pot and fry the chopped onions, sliced leeks (pale part) and sliced garlic for 2-3 minutes until translucent. Pour in the wine and cook for 3-4 minutes until completely evaporated.

Add the rinsed rice, the fried vegetables, salt and pepper. Pour in the stock to about the level of the contents without covering completely (add a little water if there is not enough) and bring to a near boil. Turn off the heat and cover with baking paper and a matching lid.
Bake for 30 minutes until the liquid is fully absorbed. Remove from the oven and rest for 10 minutes without opening.

For the aioli, process 2 egg yolks, 1 tsp salt, the lemon juice and 2 crushed garlic cloves in a food processor until combined, then drizzle in 2/3 cup canola oil gradually while processing until thick like mayonnaise.
Serve the pilaf hot with a small dish of aioli on the side.
